statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential embolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis codes I49.9 and Z86.73 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The CPT 93271 service is medically necessary
